_comment: Presentational vocabulary for the Control Room, shared by the UI (glyphs.tsx, WarningChain.tsx, OpsMap.tsx) and the validator (scripts/build-scenarios.mjs). Adding a word here without drawing it in glyphs.tsx renders nothing; using a word in a scenario that is not here fails the build. Documented in data/scenarios/README.md.

readings._comment: Instrument readings drawn on a slip (glyphs.tsx READING_GLYPHS). `label` is what the drawing prints; `says` is a case-insensitive pattern the item's own text must match, so a drawn state is always one the slip states in words.

hazards._comment: Hazard families (hazards.ts). A scenario's `hazard` picks the FIRST family whose `match` pattern it contains (case-insensitive), so order matters: fire, then storm, then water. `states` are the board's words for watch / signal / impact. The build refuses a playable scenario whose hazard names no family. Documented in data/scenarios/README.md.
